exploratory_go.answer_verbatim: Run the arms anyway, labelled exploratory (Recommended)
exploratory_go.earlier_go_verbatim: Message: "okay whats the status on bca and iw bca? we need them run if environment is working correctly". Question: "When the report confirms the environment works, should I train the BCA arms (unweighted vs importance-weighted) automatically on every quality where their checks pass?" Answer: "Yes, both kinds, all qualities (Recommended)".
exploratory_go.option_text: About 20 minutes. Trains unweighted vs weighted BCA (both uses of the band) on all five qualities, clearly marked as outside the pre-registered claims, so we see the actual numbers rather than predictions.
exploratory_go.question: No quality qualified for the BCA training arms under the pre-registered gates. What next?
